desc.zh: 用最左空位最小堆和清理后的列表尾部实现餐盘栈。
desc.en: Use a leftmost-hole min-heap and a cleaned list tail to implement Dinner Plate Stacks.

complexity: Amortized O(log n) time per operation; O(n) space

concepts.name: Leftmost available stack
concepts.description: A min-heap selects the smallest non-full index.

concepts.name: Rightmost non-empty stack
concepts.description: The list tail and cleanup expose the rightmost non-empty stack.
